svg.title: How the gates decide whether a run may launch
svg.desc: The pre-flight reads the five gates. If any of the first four carries an error, the launch is on hold. Otherwise the run may launch, with or without warnings. A base-year error holds only the final designation and the publication, never the run. Separately, an unclassified record, an unjustified scope departure or a draft at a facility in the boundary blocks the freeze itself.
